lines.zh: 我贴着地面爬，肚子几乎擦着草。
lines.en: I crawl along the ground, my belly brushing the grass.

lines.zh: 主世界哪里都能去，我就慢慢地逛。
lines.en: I can go anywhere in the overworld, so I wander.

lines.zh: 一两只同行，多一只就挤了。
lines.en: One or two of us travel; a third would crowd.

lines.zh: 我爬得不快，但我从不走回头路。
lines.en: I'm not fast, but I never retrace my path.

lines.zh: 草叶划过我的背，我懒得绕开。
lines.en: Grass blades scrape my back and I don't bother dodging.

lines.zh: 从森林爬到沙地，我用了很久。
lines.en: Forest to desert sand took me a very long time.

lines.zh: 沙上留下一条细痕，那是我走的路。
lines.en: A thin line in the sand marks the way I came.

lines.zh: 我爬过石头，也爬过别人的旧窝。
lines.en: I crawl over stones and over someone's old burrow.

lines.zh: 爬行时我低着头，眼睛只往前看一点。
lines.en: Crawling, I keep my head low and my eyes ahead.

lines.zh: 我这身甲很重，走起来咔咔响。
lines.en: This shell of mine is heavy; it clicks as I walk.

lines.zh: 领头的转个弯，后面的我就跟上。
lines.en: The lead one turns, and the rest of us follow.

lines.zh: 主世界的光太亮，我总贴着阴影走。
lines.en: Overworld light is bright; I keep to the shadows.

lines.zh: 我爬过的地方，草会慢慢立回去。
lines.en: Where I pass, the grass slowly stands back up.

lines.zh: 别催，我这副身子只能这么走。
lines.en: Don't rush me; this body only moves this fast.

lines.zh: 我挪到草根边，绕开一块硬土。
lines.en: I shift to the grass roots and go around a hard clod.

lines.zh: 两只一起爬，我的壳撞到它。
lines.en: Two of us crawl together and my shell knocks into it.

lines.zh: 我趴在土上，甲壳贴着地面。
lines.en: I lie on the soil with my shell against it.

lines.zh: 主世界的风从草上过，我不动。
lines.en: Wind crosses the grass in the overworld; I stay still.

lines.zh: 我在等土里的凉气漫上来。
lines.en: I'm waiting for the cool to rise out of the soil.

lines.zh: 两只挤在一起，甲壳互相靠着。
lines.en: Two of us press together, shells leaning.

lines.zh: 光太晒，我往草叶下面缩。
lines.en: The sun is harsh, so I shrink under the grass.

lines.zh: 我一天中大半时间都在这里趴着。
lines.en: I spend most of the day lying right here.

lines.zh: 有虫子从我面前过，我没管。
lines.en: A bug crossed in front of me; I let it be.

lines.zh: 我的触须慢慢摆，像在打拍子。
lines.en: My antennae sway slowly, keeping a kind of beat.

lines.zh: 下雨时我不躲，甲壳会自己干。
lines.en: I don't shelter from rain; the shell dries itself.

lines.zh: 这片草地我熟，哪块土松我都知道。
lines.en: I know this meadow, and which soil gives way.

lines.zh: 我缩成一团，看起来像块旧树皮。
lines.en: Curled up like this, I look like old bark.

lines.zh: 两只都趴着，谁也不先说走。
lines.en: Both of us lie still; neither suggests leaving.

lines.zh: 我把头低到土里，闻到了一股湿味。
lines.en: I lower my head to the soil and smell damp.

lines.zh: 这样趴着，比爬着舒服多了。
lines.en: Lying like this is far better than crawling.

lines.zh: 我盯着眼前一根草茎，没动。
lines.en: I stare at a grass stem in front of me and do not move.

lines.zh: 壳缝里钻进一只小虫，随它去。
lines.en: A small bug crawls into my shell seam; let it.

lines.zh: 你站得这么近，我的触须先竖起来了。
lines.en: You stand so close; my antennae rose first.

lines.zh: 我从草缝里看你，只看见一双靴子。
lines.en: I see you through the grass: mostly just boots.

lines.zh: 你手上没有草，那我就没什么好怕的。
lines.en: No plants in your hands, so I have little to fear.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，甲壳上还挂着一片叶子。
lines.en: I raise my head with a leaf stuck to my shell.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，我就把身子缩紧了一点。
lines.en: You crouch down, and I tuck my body in tighter.

lines.zh: 主世界来了个人，我见过很多次了。
lines.en: Someone from the overworld; I've seen many of you.

lines.zh: 你的影子罩住我，地上就凉了。
lines.en: Your shadow covers me, and the ground cools.

lines.zh: 我看了很久，腿还是没动。
lines.en: I've watched a long while and my legs haven't moved.

lines.zh: 你踩的那块土，是我昨晚睡的地方。
lines.en: The soil under your foot is where I slept.

lines.zh: 两只都看着你，一只看头，一只看脚。
lines.en: Two of us watch: one your head, one your feet.

lines.zh: 你身上有草的味道，我就放松些。
lines.en: You smell of grass, so I relax a little.

lines.zh: 我看了你一会儿，又低头吃草去了。
lines.en: I watch you a while, then go back to the grass.

lines.zh: 你踢了我，甲壳裂了一小块。
lines.en: You kicked me, and a corner of my shell cracked.

lines.zh: 我缩成一团，裂口还露在外面。
lines.en: I curl up, but the crack still shows.

lines.zh: 疼，可我不会丢下这片草。
lines.en: It hurts, but I won't abandon this patch of grass.

lines.zh: 我身上没有掉落，你白砍了。
lines.en: I have no loot; that swing was wasted.

lines.zh: 两只里有一只已经钻走了。
lines.en: One of the two has already burrowed away.

lines.zh: 我慢慢往土里退，只露出一半。
lines.en: I ease back into the soil until half of me shows.

lines.zh: 甲壳的颜色被血浸深了。
lines.en: Blood has darkened the color of my shell.

lines.zh: 这一下够我趴上一整天。
lines.en: That will keep me down for a whole day.

lines.zh: 我抬起腿，发现有一条不太听话。
lines.en: I lift my legs and find one won't obey.

lines.zh: 别再来一下，我爬都爬不稳了。
lines.en: Not another; I can barely crawl straight now.

lines.zh: 你手里那把草，我从三格远就看见了。
lines.en: I spotted the grass in your hand from three blocks.

lines.zh: 叶子一晃，我的腿就自己往前挪。
lines.en: A leaf waves, and my legs step forward on their own.

lines.zh: 我不挑食，草、叶、嫩芽都行。
lines.en: I'm not picky: grass, leaves, young shoots all work.

lines.zh: 你把草放低一点，我够得着就走过去。
lines.en: Lower that grass, and I'll come over if I can reach.

lines.zh: 两只一起凑上来，一根草不够分。
lines.en: Both of us crowd in; one blade isn't enough.

lines.zh: 我闻到甜味了，是熟透的浆果吧。
lines.en: I smell something sweet; ripe berries, I think.

lines.zh: 别逗我，我真的会一路跟着走。
lines.en: Don't tease me; I really will follow you the whole way.

lines.zh: 我吃东西很慢，一口要嚼很久。
lines.en: I eat slowly, chewing each mouthful for a long time.

lines.zh: 你手上的东西比地上的嫩。
lines.en: What's in your hand is tenderer than the ground's.

lines.zh: 别用肉引我，我不吃那个。
lines.en: Don't lure me with meat; I don't eat that.

lines.zh: 给我草，我就在你脚边多待一会儿。
lines.en: Give me grass and I'll linger by your feet a while.

lines.zh: 这一口下去，甲壳都舒服了。
lines.en: One bite, and even my shell feels better.

lines.zh: 我跟着草走了半片草地。
lines.en: I followed that grass halfway across the meadow.

lines.zh: 你先松手，我才敢吃。
lines.en: Let go first, and only then will I eat.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，草叶就在我嘴边。
lines.en: You crouch down, and the grass is right at my mouth.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，闻到了叶子的青味。
lines.en: I raise my head and smell green leaves.

lines.zh: 你踢到我，我的甲壳响了一声。
lines.en: You kick me, and my shell rings once.

lines.zh: 我这么矮，你走路时看不见我。
lines.en: I'm this low; you don't see me when you walk.

lines.zh: 你一脚踩下来，我缩成了一个圆。
lines.en: You bring a foot down, and I curl into a ball.

lines.zh: 两只撞在一起，滚了半圈。
lines.en: Two of us bump and roll half a turn.

lines.zh: 我退开些，草都被我压平了。
lines.en: I back away, flattening the grass as I go.

lines.zh: 甲壳上多了一道白印，不疼。
lines.en: A white mark on my shell; it doesn't hurt.

lines.zh: 你跨过去就好，别踢第二下。
lines.en: Just step over me; don't kick a second time.

lines.zh: 我翻过来要很久才能站回去。
lines.en: Once flipped, I take a long time to right myself.

lines.zh: 你踩的那块土松了，我差点陷下去。
lines.en: The soil you stepped on loosened; I almost sank.

lines.zh: 撞一下没关系，我这壳很旧了。
lines.en: One bump is fine; this shell is already old.

lines.zh: 我找一只同样贴着地爬的。
lines.en: I look for one that crawls as low as I do.

lines.zh: 两只并肩爬，甲壳轻轻相碰。
lines.en: Two of us crawl abreast, shells touching lightly.

lines.zh: 我抬了抬前腿，这是打招呼。
lines.en: I lift my front legs; that's my greeting.

lines.zh: 草地里的一对，走得很慢很慢。
lines.en: A pair in the meadow walks very, very slowly.

lines.zh: 她的壳色比我深，我记住了。
lines.en: Her shell is darker than mine, and I remember it.

lines.zh: 别过来，我们正挨着。
lines.en: Don't come closer; we are side by side now.

lines.zh: 我们绕着一块石头转了两圈。
lines.en: We circled one stone together, twice.

lines.zh: 甲壳碰甲壳，声音很轻。
lines.en: Shell against shell, and the sound is soft.

lines.zh: 等草长高一些，我们就一起搬。
lines.en: When the grass grows taller, we'll move together.

lines.zh: 成双的爬虫，走得比单只稳。
lines.en: Paired crawlers walk steadier than a lone one.

lines.zh: 你把我捧起来，我的腿还在空中划。
lines.en: You cup me up and my legs still paddle the air.

lines.zh: 我缩成一团，这样你不好拿。
lines.en: I curl up, which makes me awkward to hold.

lines.zh: 我没有掉落，你别指望从我身上拿东西。
lines.en: I drop nothing, so don't expect loot from me.

lines.zh: 离了地，我就不知道草在哪了。
lines.en: Off the ground, I lose track of where the grass is.

lines.zh: 轻些，我的甲壳比看起来薄。
lines.en: Gently; my shell is thinner than it looks.

lines.zh: 放我回草地，我会自己找路。
lines.en: Put me back in the grass and I'll find my way.

lines.zh: 你的手太暖，我有点想睡。
lines.en: Your hand is warm, and I feel a little sleepy.

lines.zh: 我会在你手里慢慢爬，别攥。
lines.en: I'll crawl slowly in your hand; don't squeeze.

lines.zh: 这一捧的高度，够我摔断一条腿。
lines.en: A drop from this height could break one of my legs.

lines.zh: 你把我放下的地方，草比我高。
lines.en: Where you set me down, the grass is taller than me.

lines.zh: 草在动，我先把头埋低。
lines.en: The grass moves, so I lower my head first.

lines.zh: 有影子过来，我停住不动。
lines.en: A shadow comes, and I freeze where I am.

lines.zh: 那脚步声比狐狸重，我认得。
lines.en: That step is heavier than a fox's; I know it.

lines.zh: 两只一起缩进草根下面。
lines.en: We both shrink down under the grass roots.

lines.zh: 我听见头顶的风停了，这不对。
lines.en: The wind above me stopped, which isn't right.

lines.zh: 它比草高得多，我看见了。
lines.en: It stands far taller than the grass; I see it.

lines.zh: 我慢慢往石缝那边挪。
lines.en: I edge slowly toward the gap between stones.

lines.zh: 是吃草的还是吃我的，我还不知道。
lines.en: Grass-eater or my eater? I don't know yet.

lines.zh: 我的触须全朝着那个方向。
lines.en: Both antennae point straight at it.

lines.zh: 先不动，动了就露馅。
lines.en: Stay still; moving would give me away.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，身子压得更低。
lines.en: I watch you and press my body lower.

lines.zh: 你要抓我，得先把草拨开。
lines.en: To catch me, part the grass first.

lines.zh: 我在往石头那边退，一步一寸。
lines.en: I'm backing toward the stone, an inch per step.

lines.zh: 两只分开走，你只能追一只。
lines.en: We split up, so you can only chase one.

lines.zh: 我的壳色跟土差不多，你看不清。
lines.en: My shell matches the soil; you can't see well.

lines.zh: 你一蹲下，我就知道要糟。
lines.en: The moment you crouch, I know it's bad.

lines.zh: 我打算钻进草里，不再出来。
lines.en: I plan to burrow into the grass and stay.

lines.zh: 别踩我，我跑不过你。
lines.en: Don't trample me; I can't outrun you.

lines.zh: 你手一抬，我就往草里沉一截。
lines.en: One lift of your hand and I sink deeper into grass.

lines.zh: 再近一步，我就翻过来装死。
lines.en: One more step and I'll flip over and play dead.

lines.zh: 我用头撞你的脚踝，很轻。
lines.en: I butt your ankle, and very lightly at that.

lines.zh: 我没有牙，只能用壳顶你。
lines.en: I have no teeth; I can only push with my shell.

lines.zh: 我用甲壳顶你一下，只想让你让路。
lines.en: One shove of my shell, only to make you step aside.

lines.zh: 你砍我，我就缩成一块石头。
lines.en: Swing at me and I shrink into a stone.

lines.zh: 两只一起顶，也推不动你。
lines.en: Two of us shove and still can't move you.

lines.zh: 我的腿在你靴子边乱蹬。
lines.en: My legs scramble uselessly against your boot.

lines.zh: 甲壳被敲了一下，声音发闷。
lines.en: My shell takes a knock and sounds hollow.

lines.zh: 我不咬人，顶多夹住草茎。
lines.en: I don't bite; at most I pinch a grass stem.

lines.zh: 打完这一下，我就爬走了。
lines.en: After this one hit, I'm crawling away.

lines.zh: 别用剑，用脚赶我就够了。
lines.en: No sword needed; shooing me with a foot suffices.

lines.zh: 我从土里钻出来，甲壳上全是泥。
lines.en: I come up out of the soil covered in mud.

lines.zh: 主世界到处都是我的地方。
lines.en: Everywhere in the overworld is my kind of place.

lines.zh: 一两只出生，各自找一片草。
lines.en: One or two are born, each finding its own grass.

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋一落地，我就开始爬。
lines.en: The spawn egg lands, and I start crawling at once.

lines.zh: 第一次抬头，光太亮了。
lines.en: My first look up, and the light is too bright.

lines.zh: 我生来就会找嫩草。
lines.en: Finding tender grass is something I was born knowing.

lines.zh: 草比我高，我在下面走。
lines.en: The grass is taller than me; I walk underneath.

lines.zh: 这一窝只有两只，够了。
lines.en: This brood has only two of us, which is enough.

lines.zh: 我在出生地趴了很久才动。
lines.en: I lay at my birthplace a long while before moving.

lines.zh: 我的壳一出生就是硬的。
lines.en: My shell was already hard when I was born.

lines.zh: 草被点着了，我的甲壳在响。
lines.en: The grass catches fire and my shell crackles.

lines.zh: 我从半空摔下来，壳磕在石头上。
lines.en: I fall from midair and my shell hits stone.

lines.zh: 水漫过背，我的腿乱蹬。
lines.en: Water closes over my back and my legs thrash.

lines.zh: 土被掀翻，我也翻了过去。
lines.en: The soil is blown up, and I flip over with it.

lines.zh: 箭钉进甲壳，拔出来会留洞。
lines.en: The arrow pins into my shell; pulling it out leaves a hole.

lines.zh: 那股药味让我爬得更慢。
lines.en: That potion smell makes me crawl even slower.

lines.zh: 草都被吃光了，我饿得发慌。
lines.en: The grass is all eaten; hunger makes me restless.

lines.zh: 雷打在草地，我的触须缩成一团。
lines.en: Lightning hits the meadow and my antennae curl up.

lines.zh: 这里没有土，我的腿抓不住。
lines.en: There is no soil here, and my legs find no grip.
